claims.summary: The v1 protocol requires separate integrated-8 GB, integrated-16 GB, discrete-8 GB, and Apple-Silicon-16 GB profiles with explicit Chrome and Edge coverage; Apple Silicon cannot satisfy the discrete seat.
A canonical stable identity binds adapter, base, training, files, runtime, conversion, and scale while excluding only the mutable promotion evidence block, avoiding a circular hash dependency.

Every passing profile must satisfy measured load, completion, native manifest-scale activation, exact rollback, repetition, memory, interrupted-download, storage-pressure, and device-loss requirements.
Required browser artifacts are path-contained and byte-verified, and adapter promotion reruns the semantic device audit after digest verification so a hash-correct failed matrix remains blocked.

The previous one-device smoke is not promoted into a four-profile claim: no quality candidate, qualifying device profile, independent review, approved training pair, or held-out adapter win currently exists, and hosted Scion remains base-only.
